017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth;
018
019import com.nimbusds.openid.connect.sdk.rp.*;
020
021/**
022 * The OIDC Dynamic Client Registration {@code application_type} (SEP-837) declared by an MCP client when it registers
023 * with an authorization server.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * This is a Juneau-owned enum so the public DCR API does not leak the Nimbus {@code provided}-scoped
027 * {@link ApplicationType} type; it maps 1:1 to the Nimbus value internally via {@link #toNimbus()}.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Per the MCP {@code 2026-07-28} client-registration spec, an MCP client <b>MUST</b> specify an appropriate
031 * {@code application_type} during Dynamic Client Registration &mdash; omitting it defaults to {@code "web"} under OIDC,
032 * which can conflict with native-style (loopback) redirect URIs.  Native apps (desktop, mobile, CLI tools, and
033 * locally-hosted web apps accessed via {@code localhost}) <b>SHOULD</b> use {@link #NATIVE}; remote browser-based web
034 * apps <b>SHOULD</b> use {@link #WEB}.  Non-OIDC (plain RFC 7591) servers safely ignore the parameter.
035 *
036 * @since 10.0.0
037 */
038public enum McpApplicationType {
039
040   /** A native app (desktop, mobile, CLI, or a loopback-hosted local web app) &mdash; maps to {@link ApplicationType#NATIVE}. */
041   NATIVE,
042
043   /** A remote browser-based web app &mdash; maps to {@link ApplicationType#WEB}. */
044   WEB;
045
046   /**
047    * Maps this Juneau enum value to the equivalent Nimbus {@link ApplicationType}.
048    *
049    * @return The Nimbus {@code application_type}.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
050    */
051   ApplicationType toNimbus() {
052      return this == NATIVE ? ApplicationType.NATIVE : ApplicationType.WEB;
053   }
054}
